title: V2V Communications Using Blockchain-Enabled 6G Technology and Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.21932v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This study proposes an interesting approach for vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) communication, which integrates blockchain technology, federated learning (FL), and allocation optimization of latency and resources. The research evaluates the proposed system using various performance metrics such as packet delivery ratio (PDR), model accuracy, and latency and demonstrates its superiority over existing techniques. Furthermore, the system provides enhanced security through consensus optimization and k-anonymity for data privacy. Overall, the proposed system is a promising solution for efficient and secure V2V communication in the era of connected and autonomous vehicles. Moreover, the proposed approach achieves higher reliability, lower latency, and better resource utilization compared to traditional 5G.

translated_title: 基于区块链赋能6G技术与联邦学习的车对车（V2V）通信
translated_abstract: 本研究提出了一种新颖的车对车（V2V）通信方法，该方法集成了区块链技术、联邦学习（FL）以及延迟与资源的分配优化。研究采用多种性能指标（如数据包投递率（PDR）、模型准确率和延迟）对所提出的系统进行了评估，并证明了其相对于现有技术的优越性。此外，该系统通过共识优化增强了安全性，并通过k-匿名技术保护数据隐私。总体而言，所提出的系统是在网联和自动驾驶汽车时代实现高效、安全V2V通信的一种有前景的解决方案。此外，与传统5G相比，所提出的方法实现了更高的可靠性、更低的延迟和更好的资源利用率。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种融合区块链、联邦学习与延迟资源分配优化的6G赋能V2V通信系统，在数据包投递率、模型准确率和延迟等指标上优于现有技术，并通过共识优化和k-匿名实现了安全与隐私的双重保障。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a blockchain-enabled 6G V2V communication system integrating federated learning and latency-resource allocation optimization, outperforming existing techniques in packet delivery ratio, model accuracy, and latency, while enhancing security through consensus optimization and k-anonymity privacy protection.
